description: Use this when the user needs a reading-time or speaking-time estimate from text or a word count. Accepts text up to 20,000 characters or 1 to 2,000,000 words, plus 100 to 1,000 wpm or a reader type. Returns a 150 to 800 wpm table; it does not assess reading ability.

reader_type.description: Optional speed profile when no numeric speed is supplied, e.g. average (250 wpm).

text.description: Optional text to count without returning it, e.g. The report has three short sections.

word_count.description: Optional known word count when text is not supplied, e.g. 1200.

words_per_minute.description: Optional reading speed from 100 to 1,000 wpm, e.g. 250.

name: estimate_reading_time
title: Estimate reading time
